Karen yawned. Long nights in nursing were bad enough, but on a psych ward rotation, it was made worse by the instability of some of the patients. Of course, the old hands on the ward were helping to shield her from the worst. She was just starting out after all. They were a good group, a little grumpy about having to work another night, but they were good.

The night started off pretty normal. Two crazy men from the state hospital had been transferred to them and she and the head nurse, Mrs. Brown, who was like a mother hen to everyone on the floor, were assigned to them for the night. They were doing fine with them. The only one that seemed like a problem was Billy. He was new and he was moody.

The next morning, Mrs. Brown told Karen to meet her at the kitchen to talk. She looked at her watch and saw that it was 11:30. "I'll be there in a second, Mrs. Brown," she said. She walked to the nurses' station and started writing up the report on Billy. She looked at her wrist watch again. It was 12:35. What the hell? She walked to the kitchen and opened the door.

She could hear Mrs. Brown crying. "What's going on?" she asked as she walked in. Her mouth dropped when she saw the body. It was the body of Billy. He was laying on the floor, on his back, staring up at the ceiling. His face was contorted. He was obviously in a lot of pain.

"What the hell happened here?!" she yelled and ran over to him and knelt down beside him. The head nurse was on the floor, kneeling in front of him too. "We found him like this." They both looked up at her and Karen could see the tears flowing down their faces. She looked at Billy.
